new_value: FIXED (f16b784ea5). Root cause confirmed: post-i72x.2 the DAO transit parent is the parent's routable upstream AddrForKey /128 (verified at production writer node.rs:1443 parent_addr=ygg_addr_from_pubkey(parent.pubkey)), so comparing it against dodag_id by same_interface low-half never matched (dodag_id[8:] is bit-packed key, not an IID) — the relay-spoof rejection was dead. FIX in router.rs process_dao_at_times: parent==dodag_id by exact 16-byte equality; sender binding = same_interface only when sender is link-local (fe80::/8), else exact equality (mirrors the node.rs forwarder gate's link-local narrowing). Verified the gate FIRES via temporary panic probe, then removed probe. Added regression test direct_child_gate_fires_on_routable_upstream_addresses (spoofed routable sender rejected, correct sender accepted, route installed only on accept) alongside the existing link-local spoofed_dao test. 90/90 routing tests green. The 6 full-suite failures (node::tests::*dao_forwarded*, rpl_stack::*) are PRE-EXISTING on baseline (confirmed by stash: identical failure set with my diff stashed) and are the nnmc/cpox parent-two-forms family — not caused by this fix. CODEREVIEW: opencode-run delegation attempted 4x, all timed out mid-exploration (7th consecutive round this happens; tool non-functional in this env). Passes done manually per fallback: correctness (gate-fire probe + both regressions), security (sender-binding logic: link-local still IID-bound, routable exact; no acceptance regression — direct child still admitted, relay still rejected; spoof can't impersonate), edge (root==node_addr exactness, link-local vs routable branch coverage). FINDINGS FILED: node.rs forwarder gate sibling bead (same dead low-half pattern for the 'we are a DAO parent' forwarder check; needs own-routable-identity input not reachable at that call site — coordinate with nnmc, do not hack in isolation). C parity: no equivalent low-half gate in lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c (root DAO process binds by full addresses + origin signature), so no C change needed.
